metadata.description: Artemis City skills for Anaconda Agent Studio and Claude — one marketplace, both ecosystems.

plugins.name: anaconda-agent-studio
plugins.description: Scaffold, configure, and ship agents for Anaconda Agent Studio: agent.yaml/pixi.toml layout, @tool authoring on anaconda_agent_runtime, MCP tool servers, multi-agent orchestration, and migrating existing Claude skills into the Agent Studio catalog.

plugins.name: artemis-transmission-protocol
plugins.description: Structured agent-to-agent communication via the Artemis Transmission Protocol (ATP): a standardized header, scoped response modes, an Artemis persona layer, and a pre-seeded SQLite tag registry.

plugins.name: artemis-anaconda-skills
plugins.description: Meta-plugin combining all Artemis City Anaconda/Claude skills; installs the anaconda-agent-studio skill and others.
